purpose: Mechanically continue only the frozen L13/V28/K24 clean-surface independent audit after the first timeout-recovery contract exhausted four 16200-second segments without completing the relaxation. The relay evaluates, from scratch, the final BFGS trial geometry proposed by the immediately preceding timed-out segment. A proposed geometry is never represented as already evaluated or accepted. After audit relaxation completion, perform the unchanged independent fixed-geometry SCF and then reapply the unchanged ten-case clean-surface gate using the already completed L11 reference and the eight immutable candidate cases.

parent_recovery.workflow_name: CO Cu111 PBE clean surface timeout recovery v1

audit_seed.reason_for_relay: Each v1 audit segment completed the force evaluation of its input geometry, emitted a new BFGS ATOMIC_POSITIONS trial, and then timed out during the SCF of that trial. Because v1 admitted only the last fully evaluated geometry as the next seed, the same geometry was re-evaluated in all four segments. Repeating v1 unchanged would therefore be non-progressing mechanical repetition.

relay_contract.trial_semantics: The final ATOMIC_POSITIONS block is admitted only when the immediately preceding section proves that its parent geometry had a completed total-energy record, a Total force record, and a BFGS Geometry Optimization step. The admitted coordinates are labelled PROPOSED_NOT_YET_EVALUATED and become only the input geometry of the next unchanged pw.x relaxation segment. They are not counted as a converged, accepted, or evaluated result until the next segment actually computes them.
relay_contract.optimizer: BFGS unchanged; unavailable BFGS history remains reset between mechanical segments
relay_contract.progress_fail_closed_rule: If a timed-out relay segment cannot prove and emit a new BFGS trial geometry distinct from its input geometry, stop with MECHANICAL_HOLD rather than repeat the same segment.
relay_contract.completion_rule: Only a pw.x relaxation that returns JOB DONE with an energy and final geometry may be promoted to RELAX_COMPLETE. Final admissibility still requires the unchanged movable-force gate and independent fixed-geometry SCF reproduction gate.
relay_contract.scratch_disposition: Discard electronic scratch after each relay segment; continuation uses only raw QE input/output plus the explicitly labelled BFGS trial geometry.

admission_rules.scientific_hold_behavior: If the unchanged clean gate returns NUMERICAL_HOLD, retain the result and stop before any site-ordering calculation.
